title: Glossaire
description: The vocabulary fiches refer to, written from Glossaire des mots-clés, Conseils d'animation and Sécurité — Référentiel. `glossary.json` at the root of an import zip; it is applied before the activities, so a fiche can use an entry the same zip adds. An entry is found by its kind and identifier: a new one is created, a known one takes the name and description given. An entry left out is kept.

tags.description: Glossaire des mots-clés: one entry per canonical keyword (a Thème subject, an Imaginaire keyword, a tag pédagogique, an « Idéal pour… » usage, a Développement family).

name.description: The canonical keyword, as the glossary writes it: « Coopérer et s'entraider ».

tips.description: Conseils d'animation — Référentiel: one entry per category.

safety.description: Sécurité — Référentiel: one entry per category.

id.description: The identifier the référentiel gives, such as `constitution-equipes`. Lowercase, no accents, words joined by -. Never changes once fiches use it.
